notes: ExtraSensory dataset. 60 subjects (34 iPhone, 26 Android), 300k+ minutes (~308,320 examples), free-living/in-the-wild: subjects used their OWN personal phones in natural routine, no scripted activities. Multi-label context (activities can co-occur), 51 context labels. Sensors per 1-minute example: phone accelerometer, gyroscope, magnetometer (measured for ~20s at 40Hz), watch accelerometer (Pebble smartwatch, ~25Hz), plus location, audio (22050Hz MFCC), phone-state, compass, watch compass. Precomputed feature vectors (225 features) and raw sensor measurements both released. Waist/pocket/hand placement uncontrolled (any convenient use). Relevant as planned free-living phone+watch TEST set for HALO. arXiv version 1609.06354 (23 pp) accepted to IEEE Pervasive Computing magazine.
